description: This Java source file defines MagnificationService, an AccessibilityService that manages display magnification in response to key events, particularly volume keys, and includes lifecycle and event handling methods.

classes.name: MagnificationService
classes.description: An AccessibilityService that handles display magnification toggling via volume keys and monitors magnification changes.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Handles accessibility events; no specific actions implemented.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Handles interruption of accessibility feedback; no actions implemented.

methods.name: onKeyEvent
methods.description: Filters and consumes volume key events to trigger magnification adjustments.

methods.name: handleVolumeKey
methods.description: Adjusts magnification scale based on volume key presses.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes service info and sets up magnification change listener upon service connection.
